title: Onboard computer usability and sunroof issues
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on onboard computer usability and dependence, with a smaller set of comments about sunroof problems.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the computer functions are easy to use.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes the computer system as overly complicated and distracting to use while driving, with one review also mentioning computer issues alongside a sunroof rattle and dealer returns for the sunroof.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention the car being heavily computer-controlled, difficulty relating to or understanding the system, and one factual note about mpg shown on the computer without clear praise or criticism.

limitations: This topic mixes two subjects—onboard computer impressions and sunroof issues—so the examples do not form a single fully coherent theme.
Most examples are brief fragments, and several are undetermined, which limits sentiment clarity for the topic.
